+# Dyadic Solenoid Path Components and Unique Time
+
+## Abstract
+
+Two points of the actual dyadic solenoid are joined exactly when a unique real-flow time translates one to the other.
+
+S2 is the existing DyadicSolenoid: compatible sequences of unit additive-circle coordinates with 2 x(n+1)=x(n), with the inherited product subspace topology. The actual additive map j=realFlow has coordinate j(t)(n)=t/2^n modulo one. This is the doubling inverse limit, distinct from the all-positive-degree UniversalSolenoid; no change of carrier or topology is made.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (A unique real translation characterizes being joined).**
+
+$$\forall x, y \in S2,\ \operatorname{Joined}(x, y) \iff \exists! t \in \mathbb{R},\ y = j(t) + x$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S1/Solenoid/DyadicPathComponent.dyadic_path_orbit_classification` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every x and y in S2, Joined x y holds if and only if there is exactly one real t with y=j(t)+x. Thus the real translation action is free and its orbits are precisely the path components. Uniqueness concerns the endpoint time, not the parametrization of the path.
+
+Translate a path from x to y by subtracting x. Lift its zeroth circle coordinate through the covering from the real line to the unit circle, with initial lift zero. Write the continuous real lift as a. Dyadic compatibility gives 2^n times coordinate n equal to coordinate zero. Both coordinate n of the translated path and the circle class of a/2^n lift that same coordinate-zero path through multiplication by 2^n. They agree initially, so covering-lift uniqueness on the connected unit interval identifies them everywhere. The endpoint is j(a(1)). Conversely u maps to j(u t)+x along the unit interval and is an explicit path.
+
+Injectivity follows directly from the dyadic coordinates. If j(t)=0, choose n with 2^n greater than the absolute value of t. Coordinate n says that t/2^n is an integer. Its absolute value is less than one, so it is zero and hence t=0. The additive kernel criterion makes j injective; cancellation supplies uniqueness of t. The local coordinate induction and kernel argument are consumed helpers, while the new construction is the identification of arbitrary dyadic paths.
+
+Let h be the parent's alternating order-three point thirdPoint. If a path joined zero to h, the classification would give h=j(t). Then r maps to j(t r) would be a continuous additive real homomorphism taking 1 to h, contradicting the parent's real-time obstruction. Consequently S2 is connected but is not path connected. The parent's algebraic rational homomorphism taking 1 to h is discontinuous and does not supply a path or a continuous real action through h.
+
+The proof reuses the pinned Mathlib covering, path-lifting, unbounded-power and additive-circle APIs and the repository's dyadic construction. The covering technique also occurs in StreamlineDecomposition for the different all-degree carrier. These are classical solenoid phenomena; no literature novelty or physical realization is asserted.
+
+## References
+

+/- GID: D5/S1/Solenoid/DyadicPathComponent
+   generality: I
+   mirror-B: D5/B/S1/Solenoid/DyadicPathComponent
+   mirror-E: none(waiver:symbolic-structural-theorems)
+   anchors: []
+   utility: none
+   digest: Unique real-flow time classifies paths in the actual dyadic solenoid. -/
+
+import D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicTimeSeparation
+import Mathlib.Topology.Covering.AddCircle
+import Mathlib.Topology.Homotopy.Lifting
+
+/-! Covering lifts identify the paths of the inherited dyadic inverse limit. -/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicSolenoid
+
+private theorem flow_injective : Function.Injective realFlow := by
+  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero realFlow).2
+  intro t ht
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt |t| (show (1 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
+  have hcoordinate := congrArg (fun x : DyadicSolenoid => x.1 n) ht
+  change (((t / (2 : ℝ)^n : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = 0) at hcoordinate
+  rcases (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff (1 : ℝ)).mp hcoordinate with ⟨z, hz⟩
+  have hzreal : (z : ℝ) = t / (2 : ℝ)^n := by
+    simpa [zsmul_eq_mul] using hz
+  have hzabs : |(z : ℝ)| < 1 := by
+    rw [hzreal, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2^n)]
+    exact (div_lt_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2^n)).2 hn
+  have hz0 : z = 0 := by
+    apply Int.abs_lt_one_iff.mp
+    exact_mod_cast hzabs
+  rw [hz0, Int.cast_zero] at hzreal
+  exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hzreal.symm).resolve_right (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
+
+private theorem coordinate_power (x : DyadicSolenoid) (n : ℕ) :
+    (2 ^ n : ℕ) • x.1 n = x.1 0 := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul, x.2 n]
+    exact ih
+
+/-- On the inherited dyadic inverse-limit topology, two points are joined precisely
+when a unique real-flow time translates the first point to the second. -/
+theorem dyadic_path_orbit_classification (x y : DyadicSolenoid) :
+    Joined x y ↔ ∃! t : ℝ, y = realFlow t + x := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨γ⟩
+    let δ : C(unitInterval, DyadicSolenoid) :=
+      ⟨fun u => γ u - x, γ.continuous.sub continuous_const⟩
+    have hδ0 : δ 0 = 0 := by simp [δ, γ.source]
+    have hδ1 : δ 1 = y - x := by simp [δ, γ.target]
+    let c : C(unitInterval, AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :=
+      ⟨fun u => (δ u).1 0,
+        (continuous_apply 0).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp δ.continuous)⟩
+    obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ := (AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe (1 : ℝ)).exists_path_lifts c 0
+      (by change (δ 0).1 0 = _; simp [hδ0])
+    have hcoord (n : ℕ) (u : unitInterval) :
+        (δ u).1 n = ((a u / (2 : ℝ)^n : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
+      have : NeZero (2 ^ n : ℕ) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)⟩
+      have hcover := (AddCircle.isAddQuotientCoveringMap_nsmul_of_ne_zero
+        (1 : ℝ) (2 ^ n)).isCoveringMap
+      have heq := hcover.eq_of_comp_eq
+        ((continuous_apply n).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp δ.continuous))
+        ((AddCircle.continuous_mk' (1 : ℝ)).comp (a.continuous.div_const ((2 : ℝ)^n)))
+        (by
+          funext v
+          change (2 ^ n : ℕ) • (δ v).1 n =
+            (2 ^ n : ℕ) • ((a v / (2 : ℝ)^n : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
+          rw [coordinate_power, ← AddCircle.coe_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul]
+          push_cast
+          rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))]
+          exact (congr_fun ha v).symm)
+        0 (by simp [hδ0, ha0])
+      exact congr_fun heq u
+    have hend : y - x = realFlow (a 1) := by
+      rw [← hδ1]
+      ext n
+      exact hcoord n 1
+    refine ⟨a 1, (sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mp hend, ?_⟩
+    intro t ht
+    apply flow_injective
+    exact add_right_cancel (ht.symm.trans ((sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mp hend))
+  · rintro ⟨t, rfl, _⟩
+    refine ⟨Path.mk
+      ⟨fun u => realFlow ((u : ℝ) * t) + x,
+        (dyadic_time_separation.2.2.1.comp
+          (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)).add continuous_const⟩ ?_ ?_⟩
+    · simp
+    · simp
+
+end D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicSolenoid

+import LeanInformationAuditInterface.Contract.Registration
+import Reg.Support.DependentFamily
+import D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicPathComponent
+
+/-! The whole original two-point law observes the actual real-flow operand.
+The typed family evidence does not supply raw source-domain selection. -/
+
+noncomputable section
+namespace Reg.D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicPathComponent
+
+open _root_.D5.S1.Solenoid
+open _root_.D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicSolenoid
+open _root_.D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.InformationEscape
+
+private theorem half_nonzero : realFlow (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hc : (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) = 0 := by
+    simpa [realFlow] using congrArg (fun x : DyadicSolenoid => x.1 0) h
+  have hz := (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico
+    (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ico 0 1 by constructor <;> norm_num)).mp hc
+  norm_num at hz
+
+abbrev signature : DependentFamily.Signature where
+  Params := Unit
+  State := fun _ => ℝ
+  Role := Unit
+  finiteRole := inferInstance
+  nonemptyRole := inferInstance
+  Output := fun _ _ => DyadicSolenoid
+  Anchor := Empty
+  finiteAnchor := inferInstance
+
+def actual : DependentFamily.Realization signature :=
+  DependentFamily.realize signature (fun _ _ t => realFlow t) (fun a => Empty.elim a)
+
+def arena : DependentFamily.Arena where
+  signature := signature
+  Law r := ∀ x y : DyadicSolenoid,
+    Joined x y ↔ ∃! t : ℝ, y = r.readout () () t + x
+
+abbrev sourceScope := type_of% (@dyadic_path_orbit_classification)
+
+private theorem source_bridge : sourceScope ↔ arena.Law actual := Iff.rfl
+
+def rejected : DependentFamily.Realization signature :=
+  DependentFamily.realize signature (fun _ _ _ => (0 : DyadicSolenoid)) (fun a => Empty.elim a)
+
+private theorem rejected_law : ¬ arena.Law rejected := by
+  intro h
+  have hj : Joined (0 : DyadicSolenoid) (realFlow (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
+    refine ⟨Path.mk
+      ⟨fun u => realFlow ((u : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ)),
+        dyadic_time_separation.2.2.1.comp (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
+      (by simp) (by simp)⟩
+  obtain ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := (h 0 (realFlow (1 / 2 : ℝ))).mp hj
+  exact half_nonzero (by simpa [rejected, DependentFamily.realize] using ht)
+
+def familyRegistration : DependentFamily.Registration arena sourceScope where
+  actual := actual
+  bridge := source_bridge
+  variation := ⟨source_bridge.mp (@dyadic_path_orbit_classification), rejected, rejected_law⟩
+  sensitivity := by
+    constructor
+    · intro i
+      refine ⟨rejected, ?_, rfl, rejected_law⟩
+      intro j hji
+      exact False.elim (hji (@Subsingleton.elim Unit _ j i))
+    · intro i
+      exact Empty.elim i
+  dependence := by
+    intro i
+    refine ⟨(), (1 / 2 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ?_⟩
+    change realFlow (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ realFlow 0
+    simpa only [map_zero] using half_nonzero
+
+def registration :
+    LeanInformationAudit.Contract.Registration.{_, _, _, 0, 0, 0, _, _, 0, 0, 0, 0}
+      (@dyadic_path_orbit_classification) (DependentFamily.Realization signature) Unit Unit where
+  unitName := `D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicSolenoid.dyadic_path_orbit_classification.__information_unit
+  realizationName := `Reg.D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicPathComponent.familyRegistration
+  realizationSource := none
+  generated := false
+  arena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  objectArena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  catalog := Lean.Name.anonymous
+  localNames := false
+  realization := .source arena ⟨familyRegistration⟩
+  correspondence := { stage := .evidence, objectStage := .evidence }
+  bundleNonempty := .evidence ⟨(show True from trivial)⟩ trivial
+  readout := some (DependentFamily.realize signature (fun _ _ t => realFlow t)
+    (fun a => Empty.elim a))
+  variation := .evidence ⟨(show True from trivial)⟩ trivial
+  sensitivity := .evidence ⟨(show True from trivial)⟩ trivial
+  partialSensitivity := none
+  escapeFrom := none
+  sourceSelection := none
+  continuation := .unknown
+  familyRecord := none
+  options := #[]
+
+end Reg.D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicPathComponent
